aiResearchSummary.text: AI Medical Service is engaged in developing an examination support device, as described in 'Examination support device, examination support method, and storage medium.' The device aims to enhance screening examinations using endoscopes by reliably acquiring necessary images and reducing subject discomfort. This research and development focus centers on improving diagnostic imaging processes for gastric cancer detection.
